title: Kit building placement record
description: One ordinary building: the plan it stands from and the frame it stands in. The plan's shell and blueprint stand in the shared store, shared by every parcel of the same family, bay count and floor count. This parcel's blueprint is that document in the frame below, under this parcel's building id.

plan.description: The plan id, which the world's plan index resolves to its shell and its blueprint.

origin.description: Where the plan's origin stands in the world: the entrance-face corner of the ground this building covers.

rotationY.description: Radians about Y that turn the plan's face 0 onto the street side. With the origin above, this is the whole transform from the plan's metres to the world's.

lot.description: The Atlas lot this parcel owns, which is what identifies the folder's ground. A merged building covers this lot and its neighbour's; the ground it actually stands on is the plan's bays in the frame above.

bounds.description: World box of the published massing, for cell binning without opening the blueprint.

signText.description: What this venue is called, for the marquee the runtime hangs on the plan's sign anchor, or null for a building with no sign.

family.description: The approved Exterior family this building wears, or null for the generator's ordinary output.

tint.description: What this building's instance colour is hashed from, so two neighbours of one family differ.

absorbs.description: The neighbouring parcel this building was merged over; that parcel stands empty.
